title: Hearty Spicy Brazilian Chicken Wrap
description: A funky and velvety meal prep Brazilian dish featuring Cajun spices and low carb friendly ingredients, inspired by ssam wraps.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together chicken breast, Cajun seasoning, and olive oil.
Spread the chicken mixture on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, heat a large skillet over medium high heat and saute the sliced red bell pepper and onion until tender.
Warm the low carb tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the cooked chicken and adding it to the tortilla along with the sauteed pepper and onion, shredded cheese, sour cream, and chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately and store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the wraps in the microwave for 30 seconds before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
